title: Private equity firm EQT partners with Google Cloud for AI rollout
title_zh: 私募股权公司 EQT 与 Google Cloud 合作推出人工智能
summary: EQT has partnered with Alphabet's ‌Google Cloud to help more than 300 companies in the Swedish private equity firm's portfolio ​accelerate the adoption of AI, the companies said on Thursday.
summary_zh: EQT 周四表示，EQT 已与 Alphabet 的 Google Cloud 合作，帮助这家瑞典私募股权公司投资组合中的 300 多家公司加速采用人工智能。

title: Why Tesla’s AI trainers don’t trust its self-driving tech
title_zh: 为什么特斯拉的人工智能培训师不信任其自动驾驶技术
summary: STORY: :: Chris Kirkham, Automotive enterprise reporter"The big promise Elon Musk has made about Full Self-Driving technology is that it will soon turn every Tesla on the road into a driverless vehicle.
summary_zh: 故事：:: Chris Kirkham，汽车企业记者“埃隆·马斯克对全自动驾驶技术做出的重大承诺是，它将很快将道路上的每辆特斯拉变成无人驾驶汽车。

title: From diapers to drugs: How India's global corporate hubs are putting AI to work
title_zh: 从尿布到药品：印度的全球企业中心如何将人工智能发挥作用
summary: May 28 (Reuters) - Whether they are recruiting the ideal "momfluencer" to sell diapers or trawling through reams of data to fast-track drug launches, global centers of multinational ‌firms in India are increasingly putting AI to work in creative ways.
summary_zh: 5 月 28 日（路透社）——无论是招募理想的“妈妈影响者”来销售尿布，还是通过大量数据搜寻快速药品上市，位于印度的跨国公司全球中心都越来越多地以创造性的方式将人工智能运用到工作中。

title: Retirement savers hit with early 2026 volatility, with many losing millionaire status
title_zh: 退休储蓄者受到 2026 年初波动的打击，许多人失去了百万富翁身份
summary: In the first quarter of 2026, the average 401(k) balance with Fidelity Investments fell by 4% from the start of the year to $141,000, according to a new report.
summary_zh: 一份新报告显示，2026 年第一季度，富达投资的平均 401(k) 余额较年初下降了 4%，至 141,000 美元。

title: Micron's AI memory boom is rewriting the chip cycle playbook: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 美光的 AI 内存热潮正在改写芯片周期剧本：每日图表
summary: Micron's rally has blown past every major memory stock boom of the past three decades.
summary_zh: 美光科技的涨幅超过了过去三十年里所有主要内存股的涨幅。

title: ByteDance making custom CPU chips to support AI rollout, sources say
title_zh: 消息人士称，字节跳动正在制造定制 CPU 芯片以支持人工智能的推出
summary: STORY: Chinese tech giant ByteDance is developing its own central processing units (CPUs) to support its growing AI infrastructure needs, according to three sources.The TikTok-parent's move comes as surging chip prices and prolonged supply shortages constrain its expansion pla...
summary_zh: 故事：据三位消息人士透露，中国科技巨头字节跳动正在开发自己的中央处理器 (CPU)，以支持其不断增长的人工智能基础设施需求。TikTok 母公司此举正值芯片价格飙升和长期供应短缺限制其扩张计划之际。

title: Micron’s Cheap Stock Valuation Seen as a Contrarian Warning Sign
title_zh: 美光科技的廉价股票估值被视为逆向警告信号
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Micron Technology Inc. is the third-best performer in the S&P 500 Index this year and at the same time one of the least expensive stocks in the market.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——美光科技公司是今年标准普尔 500 指数中表现第三好的股票，同时也是市场上最便宜的股票之一。

title: Nvidia Server Maker Wiwynn Sees AI Bottlenecks Beyond Memory
title_zh: Nvidia 服务器制造商 Wiwynn 发现内存之外的 AI 瓶颈
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Wiwynn Corp., one of the biggest makers of Nvidia Corp.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Wiwynn Corp.，Nvidia Corp. 最大的制造商之一。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures drop following US strikes in Hormuz
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货因美国在霍尔木兹的罢工而下跌
summary: US stock futures edged up as a wave of tech earnings boosted confidence in the AI trade.
summary_zh: 随着一波科技财报提振了人们对人工智能行业的信心，美国股指期货小幅上涨。
